name: Shaanxi Tourism Culture Industry Holding Co.,Ltd
summary: Shaanxi Tourism Culture Industry Holding Co.,Ltd engages in the tourism operations in China. It offers tourism performances, cable cars, and catering; and tourism project investment and management. The company sells tickets for cable car, performance and arts, and other tourism products through online and offline channels, including direct sales and agency sales. The company's agency sales through online channels. The company was formerly known as Shaanxi Tourism Co., Ltd., and changed its name to Shaanxi Tourism Culture Industry Holding Co.,Ltd in February 2025. Shaanxi Tourism Culture Industry Holding Co.,Ltd was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Xi'an, China.
